locale.clickTargetToContinue: Click the highlighted control to continue, or use Back if you want to replay the previous step.
buyer.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis
buyer.0.content: This tour mixes short orientation with real clicks. When a tab or button is highlighted, click it directly to continue.
buyer.1.title: Open the Intelligence Map
buyer.1.content: Click the Intelligence Map tab to see active Verdaxis trading corridors and port-level market context.
buyer.2.title: Open Marketplace
buyer.2.content: Click Marketplace to move into the execution workspace for listings, bids, orderbook depth, and your own orders.
buyer.3.title: Choose the Product Slice
buyer.3.content: Click the highlighted fuel chip to move from all products into a specific Verdaxis market product.
buyer.4.title: Open the Filters
buyer.4.content: Click More Filters. Port and availability window are required before the orderbook shows a precise market slice.
buyer.slicePort.title: Choose Singapore
buyer.slicePort.content: Open the Port dropdown and choose Singapore. If another port is selected, use Skip Step to reopen the dropdown and reset the tutorial sample.
buyer.slicePortOption.title: Choose Singapore
buyer.slicePortOption.content: Choose Singapore as the tutorial sample port. You can pick another port when using the marketplace normally.
buyer.sliceWindow.title: Choose Spot
buyer.sliceWindow.content: Open the availability window dropdown and choose Spot. If another window is selected, use Skip Step to reopen the dropdown and reset the tutorial sample.
buyer.sliceWindowOption.title: Choose Spot
buyer.sliceWindowOption.content: Choose Spot as the tutorial sample window so the market scope becomes executable.
buyer.5.title: Open the Orderbook
buyer.5.content: Click Orderbook to view live bid and ask depth for the selected product, port, and window.
buyer.6.title: Market Scope
buyer.6.content: The scope bar shows whether product, port, and window are selected. When all three are checked, the orderbook and trade tape appear.
buyer.7.title: Click an Ask
buyer.7.content: Click an ask level to open the trade modal. Demo levels are clearly marked and cannot be executed. If there is no clickable ask in this slice, use Skip Step to continue to posting a bid.
buyer.8.title: Review the Listing
buyer.8.content: The modal shows product, port, quantity, price, and any demo warning before any irreversible action is possible.
buyer.9.title: Review Before Trade
buyer.9.content: Click the review button to see the final warning. The tour will stop before the final confirm action.
buyer.10.title: Final Confirmation Boundary
buyer.10.content: This is the no-take-backs step. The tour highlights it for awareness but does not click it for you.
buyer.11.title: Close the Trade Modal
buyer.11.content: Close the modal to continue. The tour never submits a real trade.
buyer.12.title: Post a Bid
buyer.12.content: Click Post a Bid to open the order form. This shows how buyers add demand without submitting during the tour.
buyer.13.title: Bid Basics
buyer.13.content: The required fields define the market identity, quantity, and price for the bid.
buyer.14.title: Open Advanced Options
buyer.14.content: Click Advanced Options to view availability and certification preferences.
buyer.15.title: Submit Boundary
buyer.15.content: This button would place the bid. The tour stops here and will not create market data.
buyer.16.title: Close the Form
buyer.16.content: Click the close button in the form header to continue the tour without posting anything.
buyer.17.title: Open Forward Curve
buyer.17.content: Click Forward Curve to move from execution into market monitoring.
buyer.18.title: Hybrid Forward Curve
buyer.18.content: This chart combines benchmark mid prices with visible bid and ask context across availability windows.
buyer.19.title: Market Matrix
buyer.19.content: The matrix scans approved ports against Verdaxis market products, so it stays aligned with the marketplace catalog.
buyer.20.title: Trade Tape
buyer.20.content: The tape shows recent confirmed trades for the focused market. Demo activity is labelled.
buyer.21.title: Open This Slice
buyer.21.content: Click Open Marketplace to jump back to the focused product, port, and window.
buyer.22.title: Watchlist
buyer.22.content: Click Watchlist to monitor saved market slices and pinned listings.
buyer.23.title: Analytics
buyer.23.content: Click Analytics to review market and portfolio context.
buyer.24.title: Trade History
buyer.24.content: Click Trade History to review initiated and completed trades.
buyer.25.title: Notifications
buyer.25.content: Notifications keep trade, price, and platform updates visible. The tour is complete.
